criteria.requirement: Add pop_range(minimum=None,maximum=None,inclusive=(True,True),reverse=False) to all three sorted container families. Boundaries follow existing value/key bisect semantics, None is unbounded, inclusive flags explicit bool pair, reversed/empty interval no-op. Collect removed values (dict items) then use existing block/view slice deletion; preserve duplicates, object identity and all remaining indexes. reverse affects returned list only. Cover large cross-block windows, reverse keys and empty/full deletion; do not treat old view slicing as newly implemented capability.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
